---
title: "Connect to the Snowflake OMOP instance with DatabaseConnector"
output: html_document
---

Credentials are read from environment variables, never stored in this file. They live in
the `.Renviron` next to this file, which R loads when you open `rstudio.Rproj` and which
git ignores (open it with `usethis::edit_r_environ("project")`, then restart R):

    SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT=<account identifier, e.g. xy12345.us-east-1>
    SNOWFLAKE_USER=<user>
    SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD=<password, leave out if you sign in with single sign-on>
    SNOWFLAKE_WAREHOUSE=<warehouse>
    SNOWFLAKE_DATABASE=<database>
    SNOWFLAKE_CDM_SCHEMA=<schema that holds the OMOP tables>

## Start clean

Run this chunk by itself, first. It clears memory and restarts R so the latest `.Renviron` is read.
Run the next chunks after the restart finishes. The chunk is not evaluated when knitting.

```{r restart-clean, eval=FALSE}
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE))
invisible(gc())
if (interactive() && exists(".rs.restartR")) .rs.restartR()
```

## One-time setup

Install the package and download the Snowflake JDBC driver (Java must be available to R).

```{r setup-once, eval=FALSE}
#install.packages("DatabaseConnector")
dir.create("~/jdbc_drivers", showWarnings = FALSE)
Sys.setenv(DATABASECONNECTOR_JAR_FOLDER = "~/jdbc_drivers")
#To make the driver folder permanent, add `DATABASECONNECTOR_JAR_FOLDER=~/jdbc_drivers` to `~/.Renviron`.

DatabaseConnector::downloadJdbcDrivers("snowflake")
```


## Connect

```{r connect}
library(DatabaseConnector)
Sys.setenv(DATABASECONNECTOR_JAR_FOLDER = "~/jdbc_drivers")

# Unset variables become "", not NA: the Java driver throws a NullPointerException on NA.
env <- function(x) Sys.getenv(x, unset = "")

# Single sign-on (browser window opens): no password needed, so SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD stays unset.
# For a password login, remove "&authenticator=externalbrowser" and set SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD.
connectionDetails <- createConnectionDetails(
  dbms             = "snowflake",
  connectionString = sprintf(
    "jdbc:snowflake://%s.snowflakecomputing.com/?warehouse=%s&db=%s&authenticator=externalbrowser",
    env("SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT"), env("SNOWFLAKE_WAREHOUSE"), env("SNOWFLAKE_DATABASE")),
  user     = env("SNOWFLAKE_USER"),
  password = env("SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD")
)

connection <- connect(connectionDetails)
cdmSchema  <- env("SNOWFLAKE_CDM_SCHEMA")
```

## Test the connection

```{r test}
renderTranslateQuerySql(
  connection,
  "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_patients FROM @cdm.person",
  cdm = cdmSchema
)
```

## Disconnect

```{r disconnect}
disconnect(connection)
```

GIBleed

```{r}
giBleedCohort <- cohort(
  entry = entry(
    conditionOccurrence(GIBleed),
    observationWindow = continuousObservation(0L, 0L),
    primaryCriteriaLimit = "First"
  ),
  exit = exit(
    endStrategy = observationExit()
  )
)
giBleedCohort


```




```{r test}
cs0 <- cs(descendants(443238, 201820, 442793),
descendants(exclude(195771, 201254, 435216, 761051, 4058243, 40484648)),
name = "Type 2 diabetes mellitus (diabetes mellitus excluding T1DM and secondary)")
ch <- cohort(
entry = entry(
conditionOccurrence(cs0),
observationWindow = continuousObservation(priorDays = 365)
),
exit = exit(
endStrategy = observationExit()
)
)
chJson <- toCohortJson(ch)
ch
```

```{r}
giBleedCohortJson <- as.json(giBleedCohort)
sql <- CirceR::buildCohortQuery(
  expression = CirceR::cohortExpressionFromJson(giBleedCohortJson),
  options = CirceR::createGenerateOptions(generateStats = FALSE)
)
sql
```
